context.purpose: Run bounded 2D vector import, explicit CRS reprojection, metric buffering and rectangular clipping; publish an editable GeoPackage/project. Compute projected polygon centroids with retained attributes. Select typed feature attributes and publish grouped count/sum/mean tables with stable member IDs and explicit units.
context.assumptions: Configured QGIS Python launcher; the same implementation supports QGIS 3/4 APIs. Latest-stable 4.2.3 is the native acceptance target. A single 2D input vector layer needs a known EPSG CRS; metric buffering needs projected metre coordinates.
context.constraints: At most 10000 features and one million vertices; 2D subset only. GeoPackage feature IDs are regenerated. PNG preview is not a georeferenced raster. No automatic conversion from unrelated geometry kinds. Centroids require projected polygons and may lie outside their source geometry. Attribute selection requires unique nonempty string semantic IDs; groups use nullable string keys, numeric aggregates reject Boolean, and units are annotations without conversion. Summary side tables preserve the input vector unchanged.
context.inspection: Inspect feature counts, CRS, bounds, attributes and reopened geometry. The shared console can inspect retained text/image evidence; it does not offer a GIS map editor.
context.recovery: INVALID_ARGUMENT requires a valid EPSG identifier and positive clip extent. Close/checkpoint GeoPackage sidecars before reading. Configure native QGIS and preserve build/reopen logs on failure.
